_**User**_

create a home-screen-spec with the below details
Build a production-quality **Home Screen** for a React Native app following strict architecture and design rules.

---

## 🔒 Must Follow Existing Rules

* Data fetching ONLY via custom hooks (no useEffect in screens)
* All API calls via `src/api/client.ts`
* No hardcoded colors → use `src/theme/colors.ts`
* No hardcoded spacing → use `src/theme/spacing.ts`
* Navigation types from `src/navigation/types.ts`

---

## 🧱 Screen: HomeScreen

### Layout Structure

1. Header
2. Genre Filter Strip
3. Hero Featured Card
4. Content Rows (3 rows)
5. Infinite Scroll Indicator
6. Bottom Tab Bar

---

## 🎯 Header

* Left: flame icon + "StreamList" wordmark
* Right: notification bell icon (placeholder)
* Background:

  * transparent while scrolling
  * `surface` when at rest

---

## 🎯 Genre Filter Strip

* Horizontal scroll (no indicator)
* Chips: All, Action, Drama, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Horror, Documentary
* Active chip:

  * background: `secondary_container`
  * text: `on_surface`
* Inactive chip:

  * background: `surface_container_high`
  * text: `on_surface_variant`
* No borders
* Selecting chip updates Genre Row (local state only, NO Zustand)

---

## 🎯 Hero Featured Card

* Width: ~90% of screen
* Border radius: from spacing system (no hardcoded 16)
* Full backdrop image
* Gradient overlay (bottom 40% → surface)

Include:

* "NEW RELEASE" badge (coral-red pill, label-sm uppercase)
* Title:

  * `display-md` (Manrope)
  * overlaps bottom edge
* Synopsis:

  * `body-md`
  * `on_surface_variant`
  * max 2 lines
* Buttons:

  1. "Watch Now" (primary gradient + play icon)
  2. "Details" (surface_container_highest)

---

## 🎯 Content Rows (Reusable Component)

Create reusable `HorizontalContentRow` component.

Each row:

* Title (left) + "See All" (right)
* Horizontal scroll (no indicator)
* Card list

### Rows:

1. Trending Now → `/trending/movie/week`
2. Top Rated → `/movie/top_rated`
3. Genre Row → `/discover/movie?with_genres={id}`

---

## 🔁 Pagination Behavior

* Each row:

  * independent pagination
  * loads next page when user scrolls within last 3 items
* Show:

  * skeleton loader on first load
  * loading footer for pagination

---

## ⏳ Infinite Scroll Indicator

* Appears at end of last visible row
* Text:

  * "LOADING MORE CONTENT"
  * `label-sm`
  * uppercase
  * `on_surface_variant`
* Include spinner

---

## 🎯 Bottom Tab Bar

Tabs:

* Home (active)
* Search
* Watchlist
* Profile

Styles:

* Active icon → `primary_container`
* Inactive → `on_surface_variant`
* Glassmorphism background

---

## 🔌 Data Layer (Hooks Only)

Create hooks:

* `useTrendingMovies()`
* `useTopRatedMovies()`
* `useMoviesByGenre(genreId)`
* `useGenres()`

Rules:

* Hooks call API layer only
* API layer uses `client.ts`

---

## 🧠 Interactions

* Tap card → navigate to DetailScreen (pass movie ID)
* Tap "Details" → same navigation
* Tap "See All" → navigate to simple list screen
* Genre change:

  * resets genre row
  * fetches new data

---

## ⚠️ Edge Cases

* Empty genre → show empty state UI
* Loading → skeletons (hero + rows)
* Error → basic fallback UI

---

## ✅ Minimum Acceptance Criteria

* All 3 rows working with pagination
* Genre filter updates correctly
* Navigation works
* No rule violations

---

## 🚫 DO NOT

* Use inline API calls
* Hardcode styles (colors, spacing)
* Mix concerns (UI + data logic)
* Use global state for genre selection

---

## 📦 Expected Output

* `HomeScreen.tsx`
* `components/` (HeroCard, Row, Chip, Header)
* `hooks/` (all hooks)
* `api/` (if missing endpoints)
* Clean, modular, production-ready code
